title: [dev-g] BG Source gets reset to BYODA when switching to latest build
body:
Switching to latest dev build (d57ec150a5789a61f15c2781bf20ea5a90ae0644), the BG Source (in my case xDrip+) gets reset to BYODA.
Is it possible to retain that setting?

comments.body: It didn't happen to me. is it repeatable?
It happened to me, I had xDrip as source then was switch do BYODA

right. it's due to https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/c71fc275a544bd3ae477549e8786e4188a69fe70 where XdripPlugin was renamed to XdripSourcePlugin to have original name preserved for xDrip synchronization plugin. 
I believe new naming convention is more logical but it means we cannot resolve this issue.
We must mention it in release notes
